title: Configurable PII redaction, retention, and audit events for embeddings & reranking
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement configurable controls for PII handling in embeddings and reranking endpoints so customers can choose redaction, retention windows, and required audit events. This ticket covers API flags, server-side enforcement, secure storage of trace logs, and a rollout plan that preserves latency and throughput targets.
acceptance_criteria: API: New optional request fields: pii_handling (values: redact, hash, retain), retention_seconds (integer), audit_level (none, minimal, full).
Server: Requests flagged for redaction never materialize in plaintext logs or persisted cache. KV cache must honor redaction and not store PII.
Audit: When audit_level=full, create tamper-evident audit events with user_id, model, request_hash, and retention metadata written to audit topic.
Retention: retention_seconds respected for ephemeral traces; background job deletes or masks data after TTL.
Performance: 99th percentile latency increase <= 10% for typical embedding batch sizes under default settings.
Tests: Unit and integration tests validate redaction, retention TTL, and that audit events are emitted with correct schema.
tasks: Design API schema and update OpenAPI spec
Server implementation: request validation and enforcement hook
KV cache changes: tagging entries with pii_handling metadata
Audit pipeline: event schema, Kafka topic, and consumer that writes to encrypted audit store
Retention worker: TTL enforcement and secure deletion/masking
Update SDKs and internal clients to expose new options
Add e2e tests and load tests to validate latency/throughput
Create runbook and rollout plan with feature flags

design_decisions: Default behavior: redact for hosted customers unless explicitly enabled by enterprise contract.
Represent redaction as deterministic token-level mask + request_hash so rerank reproducibility is possible without storing original PII.
Audit events will contain HMAC(request_payload) rather than plaintext and include a key version reference for traceability.
Retention model: soft-delete then cryptographic wipe after retention window for encrypted objects; for caches, overwrite with randomized bytes then free memory.
Expose settings at request level and tenant-level config; tenant-level defaults enforced by server policy with override restrictions.
risks: Inadvertent storage of PII in third-party telemetry pipeline if not correctly filtered.
Performance regression under high QPS when audit_level=full and retention_seconds long.
Operational complexity: key management for HMAC and encrypted audit store introduces rotation and availability concerns.
mitigation: Add a pre-ingest filter that blocks or masks known PII patterns before any logging/telemetry emit.
Rate-limit full-audit paths and provide sampling controls to reduce load at extreme QPS.
Integrate KMS-backed key rotation automation and add monitoring/alerts for audit writer failures.
test_plan: Unit tests for API validation and pii_handling enumeration.
Integration tests: end-to-end request -> cache -> audit pipeline ensuring redacted content not present in outputs.
Load tests with redaction and full-audit enabled to assert latency SLOs and resource usage.
Security fuzz tests to ensure known edge PII patterns are caught and not leaked.
rollout_plan: Feature flag behind tenant opt-in; enable for internal sandbox tenants first.
Canary to 5% of traffic for 48 hours with elevated monitoring on latency and audit writer errors.
Ramp to 25% then 100% if no regressions; enterprise tenants can opt-in earlier via admin console.
Post-rollout: 7-day regression monitoring and follow-up bugfix window.
monitoring: SLO: p99 latency delta for embeddings endpoint <= 10% vs baseline
Alert: stale audit writer offsets or consumer lag > 5 minutes
notes: Coordinate with infra team for encrypted audit storage provisioning (ENG-8820).
